symptom: Self-maintenance structured QA accepted Black, isort, and source-governance evidence where the required command was followed by a newline and true, allowing the final true command to supply exit code 0 even when the required gate failed.
root_cause: The fail-closed command tokenizer recognized semicolon, ampersand, and pipe punctuation but shlex treated carriage returns and line feeds as ordinary whitespace, so matchers still found the required command while ignoring the shell command boundary.

+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_quality_gate.py
@@ -13,6 +13,8 @@ from typing import Any, Optional
 def _safe_command_tokens(command: str) -> Optional[list[str]]:
     """Tokenize a reported command without guessing past malformed quoting."""
 
+    if "\n" in command or "\r" in command:
+        return None
     try:
         lexer = shlex.shlex(command, posix=True, punctuation_chars=";&|")
         lexer.commenters = ""

executable_template.applicability_check: Submit Black, isort, or source-governance evidence with the required command followed by a line feed or CRLF and a successful final command, then confirm whether the corresponding matcher incorrectly returns true.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Reject command evidence containing carriage returns or line feeds before shell tokenization, while retaining punctuation-aware parsing and valid one-line fail-propagating command chains.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the multiline rejection and its regression test together, and disable unattended structured QA acceptance until an equivalent parser can prove the reported exit code belongs to the required command.
